title: OS command execution via rawSystem (haskell) — review required
description: The haskell sink rawSystem launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via readProcess with args.
remediation: Use readProcess with args with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any rawSystem call matches.
